speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand your wife is concerned about your recent bizarre and agitated behavior; to help me understand what is happening, can you tell me how long these episodes have been occurring and if you have experienced any fever or headache?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia. The presentation of bizarre behavior, paranoia (persecutory and delusional content involving the NSA), and functional decline over 6 weeks, combined with a 3-month prodrome of social withdrawal and depression, is highly characteristic of this condition.
